summary: Implemented rule E3695 in the cfn-lint repo to validate ElastiCache CacheCluster engines. Changes: new rule src/cfnlint/rules/resources/elasticache/CacheClusterEngine.py (CfnLintJsonSchema-based, case-insensitive engine check); new schema src/cfnlint/data/schemas/extensions/aws_elasticache_cachecluster/engine_enum.json allowing memcached, redis, valkey; new unit test test/unit/rules/resources/elasticache/test_cache_cluster_engine.py; and a docs/rules.md row for E3695. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. The engine list is hardcoded rather than generated from AWS data, since there was no network access. The test's expected error message and rule fields are hand-written and unverified.
